feed_summary: Overview On November 19, 2026, Broadcom published VMware Security Advisory VMSA-2026-0009 , addressing five vulnerabilities in VMware products. The most severe of these, CVE-2026-123890 , is an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel ( CWE-288 ) in the VMware Directory Service component of vCenter. Broadcom assigned the vulnerability a critical CVSSv3 score of 9.8 . A malicious actor with network access to an affected vCenter deployment may exploit CVE-2026-123890 without credentials to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system as the Administrator user. Mandiant privately reported the issue to Broadcom. Also, Mandiant/Google Threat Intelligence confirmed in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-123890 by Chinese state-linked threat actor ARMORY CASTLE a
title: CVE-2026-123890: Critical Authentication Bypass in VMware vCenter
